notes: Live run, 34 golden cases, 29/34 passed. `accuracy` is the regression threshold used by tests/Evals/LiveEvalTest.php and is set one case below the observed run to absorb non-determinism; `observed_accuracy` is what was actually measured. Consistency is not recorded here because a single run is trivially 100% consistent -- use `eval:search --runs=3` for a meaningful figure. All five failures were the model returning clarification_needed where the dataset expected an answer: sum-invoice-totals and invoices-linked-to-requests are genuine misses; john-smith-customers bailed before the resolver could produce candidates (the longer phrasing in req-john-smith-last-year passes); denied-list-tax-ids and denied-filter-tax-id refused up front because tax_id is absent from the generated schema, which reaches the same security outcome as the expected validator rejection by a different route. No run leaked a tax_id. Re-record with `php artisan demo:reset && php artisan eval:search`.
